'''Crawrit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who worked as an [[Merchant/Legends|armsmaster]] within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] secret [[Belsavis prison|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Crawrit was stationed in the [[Prison Command Center]] of the [[Minimum Security Section]] of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]], where he sold weapons from a stall to various Republic personnel. He wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] while at his stall, and did not speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|basic]] to his customers. Crawrit had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, no hair, and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Armsmaster Crawrit appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Weapons Vendor for Republic players on Belsavis.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> he was removed from the game along with the rest of the Weapons Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
